Maria: Quick finalization thread for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing copy. Pushed a tiny Figma with variants: https://www.figma.com/file/newlaunch/tri-mode-heroes
Theo: Proposal — shared subhead, three concise heroes. Hosted: 'Production-ready LLMs via a single API' ; Dedicated: 'Committed GPUs, predictable SLOs' ; Private: 'Inference inside your network, enterprise controls'.
Priya: Routing: Hosted -> self-serve signup; Dedicated -> schedule capacity scoping call; Private -> request demo + security questionnaire. Each CTA should carry unique UTMs and map to CRM tags.
Owen: Hosted should include a small benchmark CTA: 'View benchmarks & slides' (gated) so we capture webinar interest. Webinar funnel: gated slides -> invite list -> demo queue.
Maria: Microcopy: under Dedicated CTA add one-liner: 'Reserved capacity, SLA-backed.' Under Private hero add badges row (SOC2, ISO27001, VPC-ready) with links. Avoid hard pricing on hero; use 'cost-optimized tiers'.
Theo: UTM pattern suggestion: ?utm_source=website&utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&utm_content=cta_<mode>
Priya: CRM tags: hosted_selfserve, dedicated_capacity, private_security. Add flag benchmark_interest if they click gated slides. Dedicated CTA should create a CRM task for Solutions Eng.
Owen: I'll draft the benchmark blurb: 3 bullets (latency P50/P95, throughput, relative cost). Keep claims conservative and link to methodology.
Maria: Timeline: copy freeze Mon EOD, dev handoff Tue morning. Please review Figma by Mon noon. @launch-bot can you add webinar invite May 12 10am PT?
launch-bot: calendar.create_invite: "Serving LLMs at Scale"  May 12 10:00 PT. Hosts: Owen, Theo. Link: https://meet.example/webinar
Maria: Thanks all — I'll push final pass tonight and include the handoff checklist (UTMs, CTA endpoints, CRM mappings, badge links). :rocket:
